about: Fakin' it: everyone answers q on their phone, except one player who gets x instead. Both are the same type, so the faker's answer can blend in. t: who = point at a player (you can pick yourself), num = type a number, yn = yes or no. Either question can end up as the real one. wild rounds only play on No holds barred.
